title: Split Horizon
text: Every forced road divides into two equally real injuries.
flavor: The horizon cannot agree where you landed.
origin: A false route tore the operative across two adjacent possibilities.
burdenText: The first forced displacement each round travels one additional legal graph step.
adaptationText: Once per round, choose between the resolver's legal forced-displacement directions.
trigger: The first forced displacement each round.
penalty: Travel one additional legal graph step.

effect.text: Split Horizon extended the forced route.

relief: Purge this Scar at the Sable Machine Choir.
upside: Choose between legal directions once per round.
